why: Holds for setters and attachControl, but interpolateArcRotateCamera clamps its goals to hand-written limit fields with no setCameraLimits call (radius goal 1 ended at a hand-set lowerRadiusLimit 5).
Drag and wheel fill offsets and nothing moves without a scene, and pinch writes radius, but keyboard input fills no offsets at all without a scene since its polling runs in the frame hook.
target.x writes mark the camera dirty, and after replacing target with a plain object the world matrix stays stale until alpha changes.
Arc camera has nearPlane 0.1, farPlane 1000, fov 0.8; free camera has nearPlane 1, farPlane 10000.
Projection takes the aspect per call and getEffectiveAspectRatio multiplies by viewport width/height.
Result x/y include the viewport offset and cssX/cssY scale by css/backing size, equal to x/y without css sizes.
resolveCameraViewport flips y to the top, floors start, ceils end, clamps to the target and returns the full target when unset.
A hand-assigned ortho is ignored before any enableOrthographicCamera in the process and does not invalidate the cached projection afterwards.
Outside writes, attachControl wheel inertia and a newer interpolation all reject the promise with that exact message.
Writing center.y left position and worldMatrixVersion unchanged; assigning a vector copied it and recomputed the pose.
Setting pitch at the start radius gives 0.001; after radius 100 or in one setGeospatialOrientation call pitch 1 holds.
_yaw/_pitch come from atan2 at creation and the next control input resets target along the old yaw.
Near maps to depth 1 and far to 0 for both perspective and orthographic projection.
z is 1 at nearPlane, and offscreen/clipped follow the stated conditions for behind, outside and depth-out points.
Holds, but a write of the unchanged value does not run the clamp hook, so a hand-lowered limit is not applied by that write (radius=10 stayed 10 above upperRadiusLimit 6).
beta is clamped to [0.01, PI-0.01] only on rotation-inertia frames and radius floored at 0.01 only on zoom; direct writes are untouched.
keyboard:true attached before enableArcRotateKeyboardControls adds no key listener and stays dead after enabling; false or omitted adds none.
A deltaY 30 wheel event set inertialRadiusOffset to -30*radius/3000 and radius grew by that amount.
Right drag added -dx/50 and +dy/50 and the frame moved target by offset*radius/1000 along the right and up vectors.
Omitted fields and inertia are read and zeroed on the first frame, and one frame of dt=factor closes half the gap.
A flight cut off by a newer flight or by key input resolves; yaw goes the short way and the default 1000 ms cubic ease holds.
Center, yaw, radius, nearPlane and farPlane match, but the starting pitch is 0.001 (pitchMin), not 0.
+Z is north and the angle conventions hold, but the center is clamped to about 87.13 deg latitude (sin limit 0.99875), not 89.96 deg.
createGeospatialLimits returns exactly those defaults, radiusMin 10 regardless of planet size.
Stale-cache and stale-terms behaviour hold, but a different aspect ratio also rebuilds the matrix, not only a camera move or fov/near/far change.
fov is ignored in ortho, halfHeight defaults to 1, null planes derive from halfHeight*aspect and a number fixes a plane.
Without a scene, keys and drags move neither free control camera.
The same buffers are returned and rewritten in place after a change.
Holds when the flag is set before the view is cached, but setting _useFloatingOrigin by hand after a getViewMatrix call keeps the cached translation until the camera moves.
Ortho points behind the camera get behindCamera with clipW 1, offscreen x stays unclamped, and clipW 0 or NaN input gives NaN fields with both flags.
Each listed invalid option throws RangeError, and negative finite offsets are accepted.
disposeScene left the listeners, the cleanup removed them twice safely, and onSceneDispose tied them to disposal.
Button 0 rotates, 2 pans, middle does nothing, and mappings change mouse and pen but touch still rotates.
Pinch sets radius by the distance ratio with no inertia, then limits and the 0.01 floor apply.
Each default binding, its rate, diagonal normalisation, Ctrl over Alt and Meta blocking all held.
alpha and beta took the shortest arc and ended exactly at the goal values when the promise resolved.
Out-of-range radius and beta goals ended at the limits while the target goal was reached unclamped.
Omitted fields kept their bound, explicit undefined cleared one, and the disposer left the values but stopped clamping.
Max pitch is pitchMax at 2R, the midpoint at 3R, pitchMin at 4R, and pitchMax at any radius with null.
Lowering limits.radiusMax left the radius until the next yaw change clamped it.
Keys are listened for on window; Up moves the center north, Ctrl+Right yaws, Equal/NumpadAdd zoom in and Minus/NumpadSubtract zoom out.
Right drag rotated, left drag moved the center without yaw change, and double-click flew only the center.
Setting camera.viewport changed nothing in a zoom toward the cursor, which uses the canvas rect and the planet sphere.
Rotation stopped the frame after input while wheel zoom kept coasting, and deltaY 1 and 500 zoomed alike.
After zoom the center sat on the planet surface, and with checkCollisions the eye was lifted to planetRadius+radiusMin.
An out-of-range radius was clamped to radiusMax, and at mid-flight the center lay on the great circle lifted by hopScale*distance.
Bindings hold, but only mouse buttons 0, 1 and 2 turn; button 3 and up do not.
A held key adds speed*dt/316.2, accumulators decay by inertia and snap to zero, and pitch is clamped at PI/2-0.01.
upKeys replaced Space, fastKeys alone did nothing, and fastMultiplier 3 tripled the step.
Writing upVector rolled the matrix, controls still moved along world Y, and a degenerate up gave identity.
Listeners are on the canvas with tabIndex set to 0, blur cleared held keys, and a custom right key replaced ArrowRight.
A fov or nearPlane write showed up in the next projection call, compared by value.
A second enableOrthographicCamera call replaced camera.ortho and writes to the old object did not change the matrix.
Ortho bounds are measured around the view axis in world units, with depth taken from nearPlane/farPlane.
shouldHandlePointerDown false skipped the press, isExternalPickPending swallowed moves, and isExternalDragActive ended the drag and zeroed only the alpha/beta/pan offsets.
No validation, the world translation is applied, zero-size viewports collapse the output, and only x, y, z are written.
